excerpts.house: Please wait outside of the house

messages.c1m1: Hey Mathew, can you take a look at the new theme tokens?
messages.c1m2: I pushed the updated palette to the shared branch.
messages.c1m3: Nice, I will review it before lunch.
messages.c1m5: Looks great, let us ship it today.
messages.c2m1: Good morning! Are we still on for the checkup call?
messages.c2m2: I can send over the notes from last session.
messages.c2m3: Morning! Yes, same time works for me.
messages.c3m1: The build pipeline is failing again on the staging job.
messages.c3m2: I attached the log dump for you.
messages.c3m3: Found it, a missing environment variable.
messages.c3m4: Adding it to the secrets manager now.
messages.c4m1: Are you home? I am around the corner.
messages.c4m2: Give me five minutes, I am wrapping up a call.
messages.c4m4: Please wait outside of the house.
messages.c5m1: The new lesson widgets are ready for review.
messages.c5m2: I kept the card radius consistent with the rest.
messages.c5m3: Checking the pull request right now.
messages.c6m1: Do you have the final illustrations for the course?
messages.c7m1: The lesson progress endpoint is returning stale data.
messages.c7m2: Cache headers look wrong to me.
messages.c7m3: Good catch, the CDN rule was missing.
messages.c8m1: Here is the updated component inventory.
messages.c8m2: Page templates are included as well.
messages.c8m4: I will add comments by tomorrow.
messages.c9m1: Access for the new students has been granted.
messages.c9m2: They can start with the placement quiz.
messages.c9m3: Perfect, I will welcome them in the group.
messages.c9m4: Also, the weekly report is ready.
messages.c10m1: Reminder: the health workshop starts at six.
messages.c10m2: I saved you a seat near the window.
messages.c10m3: Thank you, I will be there on time.

feed.title: Add your classes to Google Calendar or Outlook
feed.description: A private link your calendar app checks every hour. Anyone with the link can see your class times, so do not share it. Creating a new link turns the old one off.
feed.instructions: Google Calendar: Other calendars → + → From URL. Outlook: Add calendar → Subscribe from web. Copy it now: for your security it is shown only once.
feed.existingWarning: You already have a link. Create a new one only if you lost it or think someone else has it.
